name: Pattern 5: Resource Description
description: Describes an NFDI resource (software, ontology, document, publication or service) by attaching multiple Information Content Entities through object properties that are refinements of iao:is_about. The ICEs cover title, abbreviation, subject area, file format, specification, version, license, citation, standard, repository, external identifiers and textual entities such as keywords, requirements and affiliations.
competency_questions: What is the title and DOI of a given resource, and which abbreviation stands for that title?; Which version number, licence and code repository are recorded for a given piece of software?; Which document describes a given resource, and which part of that document is the one that covers it?
competency_questions_source: derived from the pattern's own axioms during the OntoBoard review and checked against them; the upstream submission states none
